schedule.title: Establishment nutrition
schedule.message: Focus on healthy establishment. Follow your soil-test and local crop recommendation before applying nutrients.

schedule.title: Vegetative nutrition
schedule.message: Review the nutrient plan for active leaf and stem growth, considering what has already been applied.

schedule.title: Prepare for flowering
schedule.message: Review the next scheduled nutrient application and avoid repeating an application already recorded.

schedule.title: Flowering-stage nutrition
schedule.message: The crop is flowering. Review stage-specific nutrition against your soil-test and previous application.

schedule.title: Support fruit set
schedule.message: Review nutrient needs for fruit setting while keeping a record of previous applications.

schedule.title: Fruit-development nutrition
schedule.message: Review the crop plan for fruit development and only apply what is due for your field.

schedule.title: Maturity-stage review
schedule.message: Avoid unnecessary late applications. Follow crop and local expert recommendations.

schedule.title: Harvest period
schedule.message: Focus on harvest and crop records. Only perform applications that are appropriate for the harvest interval.
